_about: Names that belong to the made-up world, and how time works. Names are placeholders until we pick the final ones; change them here and they change everywhere.
_chapters: For each stage of life: how many real minutes a played day lasts, and how many days pass between played days (a year is 120 days). Together these make a whole life about 25 hours long.

stageNames.child: You're not a baby any more. You can walk properly now, and talk, and ask why.
stageNames.teen: You're a teenager now. Everything feels bigger.
stageNames.adult: You're an adult now. Your life is your own.
stageNames.elder: The years have caught up with you. Your hair is grey and your steps are slower.
